locator: S3.5 Creating A Rollback Journal; S3.7 Flushing The Rollback Journal File To Mass Storage ('critical step in insuring that the database can survive an unexpected power loss'); S3.11 Deleting The Rollback Journal ('instant where the transaction commits'); S4.2 Hot Rollback Journals ('database file is in an inconsistent state'); S9 Things That Can Go Wrong (broken fsync, NFS locking)
